# Third-party assets

Allowed licenses: CC0, MIT and CC BY with credit given here (see docs/DECISIONS.md, D-025, which replaces D-011).

| Folder | Pack | Author | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KayKit/Adventurers` | KayKit Adventurers 2.0 (free) — Knight, Mage and Rogue_Hooded hero models, weapons (sword, shield, staff, bow, dagger) | Kay Lousberg | https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers | CC0 1.0 |
| `KayKit/Skeletons` | KayKit Skeletons 1.1 (free) — skeleton walkers and weapons | Kay Lousberg | https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-skeletons | CC0 1.0 |
| `KayKit/Animations` | KayKit Character Animations 1.1 — Rig_Medium clips | Kay Lousberg | https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-character-animations | CC0 1.0 |
| `KayKit/Dungeon` | KayKit Dungeon Pack 1.1 (free) — floor, walls, torches, props | Kay Lousberg | https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-dungeon-pack | CC0 1.0 |
| `KayKit/Halloween` | KayKit Halloween Bits 1.0 — graves, dead trees, fences, pumpkins (70 OBJ models + 1 texture) | Kay Lousberg | https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Halloween-Bits-1.0 | CC0 1.0 |
| `Audio/KenneyImpactSounds` | Impact Sounds — hits, kills, shield, kick and boss impacts (only the used `.ogg` files) | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds | CC0 1.0 |
| `Audio/KenneyRpgAudio` | RPG Audio — blade swings, cloth whooshes, crossbow latch, coins, chest door | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio | CC0 1.0 |
| `Audio/KenneyInterfaceSounds` | Interface Sounds — button click, error, switch, gem blip, card sounds, bow plucks | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds | CC0 1.0 |
| `Audio/KenneySciFiSounds` | Sci-fi Sounds — magic bolt, arcane beam, fire orb, mana shield, explosions, boss roar, elite growl | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/sci-fi-sounds | CC0 1.0 |
| `Audio/KenneyDigitalAudio` | Digital Audio — lightning zaps, blink, heal, magnet, level-up, summon | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/digital-audio | CC0 1.0 |
| `Audio/KenneyMusicJingles` | Music Jingles — victory, defeat, end-of-run and evolution jingles | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/music-jingles | CC0 1.0 |
| `Audio/Music` | Run loop "When the Shadows Gather" (Tsorthan Grove) and boss loop "Heavy Boss Battle 2" (MintoDog) | Tsorthan Grove, MintoDog | https://opengameart.org/content/when-the-shadows-gather, https://opengameart.org/content/heavy-boss-battle-2 | CC0 1.0 |
| `GameIcons` | 70 skill and survivor item icon files (one glyph per skill or item id; per-file list in `GameIcons/License.txt`) | Lorc, Delapouite, Carl Olsen, Skoll | https://game-icons.net | CC BY 3.0 |
| `../Arena/View/Art/AppIcon.png` | Viewer app icon (M8 build), composed from the "spinning-sword" glyph (Lorc) and the "two-coins" glyph (Delapouite), recoloured on a dark round badge | Lorc, Delapouite | https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/spinning-sword.html, https://game-icons.net/1x1/delapouite/two-coins.html | CC BY 3.0 |

Each pack keeps its original license text (the music folder's `License.txt` lists both tracks). CC0 needs no attribution but it is given anyway; CC BY icons must stay credited here.
